newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SINGAPORE RUBBER FUTURES CLOSE NARROWLY MIXED.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE RUBBER FUTURES CLOSE NARROWLY MIXED.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed narrowly mixed in moderate trade on Tuesday on some late local buying and selling interest, brokers said.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives. But prices were narrowly mixed in the afternoon amid uncertainty over the near term direction of the market," a local broker said.

"Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were higher but there was little impact on the market here. The closure of the Thai market for the (Queen's Birthday) holiday in Thailand also limited activity," another local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, November RSS3 fell two cents to 95.50 U.S. cents a kg.
September RSS1 rose 1.50 cents to 138.50 Singapore cents (92 U.S. cents) a kg.
September TSR20 Award rose one cent to 141.00 Singapore cents (94 U.S. cents) a kg.
November TSR20 FOB fell 0.50 cent to 97.00 U.S. cents a kg.
